section_summary.extract_value: This section reports descriptive statistics and correlations from a single unnamed study (Study X). It states that BMI correlated negatively with body appreciation (assessed with BAS-2) at a moderate magnitude and that body appreciation was negatively associated with inflexible eating and EDE-Q; other reported relationships among SSPS, IEQ, and EDE-Q are also described.
section_summary.evidence_source: Descriptive statistics for the study variables are presented in Table 1. Results from correlation analyses revealed that BMI presented negative correlations with social safeness (SSPS) and body appreciation (BAS-2), with weak and moderate magnitudes, respectively. Also, body appreciation was negatively correlated with both inflexible eating and EDE-Q, with moderate and strong magnitudes respectively.
